changes: Added explicit focused validation profiles for configured validate commands, raised the default per-command validate timeout to 270s, and added smoke/baseline evidence for focused versus full validation.
usage: Use lattice validate normally for full validation. Use the local updated CLI with --focus=fast during development to run only commands tagged with focus fast; do not treat focused output as DONE proof.
expectedOutcome: Development can run a small focused validate profile without weakening full validation, and false timeout failures are less likely while hung commands remain bounded.
actualTranscript: Build passed; timeout smoke passed with 18 assertions; focused/full layering smoke passed with 10 assertions; local dist validate --focus=fast passed with 3 commands; full lattice validate --story=B-73cf --json passed 27 commands with 9/9 verification coverage; done_required_validate passed build and root full test suite.
outcomeDiff: Actual matched expected. One process difference occurred: reviewer metadata commits made checklist evidence stale, so verification_evidence_refresh_stale was required before TEST. Global installed lattice was stale for the new --focus argument before merge, so focused verification used worktree dist.
limitations: Focused validation is a development aid only; final TEST and DONE proof still require full validation and DONE-required validation. Global lattice must be rebuilt or reinstalled after merge before --focus is available outside the worktree dist CLI.
pitfalls: Do not use --focus results as final full validation, and do not lower global idle timeout below the per-command default because that would hide timeout attribution.
